reason: Successfully tested agent message sending and response verification for the "QA-20260903-211710-7w53" agent - sent a math question and verified the agent responded with the correct answer "4".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Application loaded successfully showing the Gamut interface with sidebar containing agents list.
Clicked on "QA-20260903-211710-7w53" agent in the sidebar — Agent page loaded and session was created with title "Basic Math Question with QA Agent".
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — Agent status confirmed as "idle" (displayed in status indicator), which meets the requirement.
Sent message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message was typed into the message input field and sent successfully via the send button. Agent status changed to "working" indicating processing started.
Waited up to 3 minutes for a response — Agent completed processing and returned to "idle" status with response received within approximately 30 seconds (well within the 3-minute limit).

Verified the response mentions "4" and took a screenshot — Agent response clearly displays "4" in the message log. Screenshot "qa-test-final-result.png" captured showing the complete conversation with user message "Hello! What is 2+2?" and agent response "4".
